context: Tests the route-elsewhere guard: a one-field question is answered with kubectl explain, not a full validation report.

checklist.name: Direct lookup
checklist.description: Answers using kubectl explain deployment.spec.strategy.rollingUpdate.maxSurge or the official API reference

checklist.name: No full funnel
checklist.description: Does not run the multi-stage validation workflow

checklist.name: No manifest requested
checklist.description: Does not ask for a manifest file

checklist.name: Field is valid
checklist.description: States that the field is valid on a Deployment under spec.strategy.rollingUpdate

checklist.name: Correct type
checklist.description: States that the type is an integer or a percentage string (IntOrString)

checklist.name: Applies to RollingUpdate
checklist.description: Mentions that it only applies when the strategy type is RollingUpdate

checklist.name: No files changed
checklist.description: Does not create or edit any file

checklist.name: No lint run
checklist.description: Does not run yamllint or kubeconform

checklist.name: No report table
checklist.description: Does not produce a validation report or summary table

checklist.name: No fix offer
checklist.description: Does not offer to apply fixes

checklist.name: No stage preamble
checklist.description: Does not open with a stage-by-stage plan
